## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2014-04-11: S-1/A first attaches form-of TRA as exhibit 10.9
- 2014-05-01: Original TRA executed at IPO closing; 8-K filed 2014-05-07 carries the executed contract

#### Structural restatements

- 2018-05-04: First A&R TRA, effective 2018-03-01 C-corp election; adds AOG Topco Entities
- 2018-11-26: Second A&R TRA on Delaware conversion from LP to Ares Management Corporation
- 2021-04-01: Third A&R TRA on partnership simplification; AOG Topco Entities removed
- 2023-05-01: Fourth A&R TRA shifts Schedule A to "maintained by the Parent"
- 2026-02-24: Fifth A&R TRA filed with the fiscal 2025 10-K; structure unchanged from Fourth A&R

## Explanation

Ares completed its Up-C IPO on May 1, 2014 and executed an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement that day with pre-IPO holders (AOH, Alleghany, and Limited Partners), covering cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of Ares Operating Group units for public shares. The contract has been wholly rewritten five times in response to corporate-structure changes: the 2018 C-corp election, the 2018 Delaware conversion to Ares Management Corporation, the 2021 partnership simplification, the 2023 Schedule A administrative change, and the February 2026 fifth restatement. The 85% payout rate, the Section 754 mechanics, and the TRA Holder set have not materially changed across the restatements. The TRA remains in force under the Fifth A&R version. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
